edge.scene: Visual consistency of the existing specification listing and editor

edge.expect: Preserve SSR category data, original GET/PUT protocol and permissions. Required bilingual fields, labels, validation messages and Save remain visible and keyboard usable. Three-viewport density/overflow/real-GIF and post-save GET evidence proves the style migration removes no function.
